svg.title: ACID: the four guarantees, the rule and the intuition for each
svg.desc: Four panels, one per ACID guarantee, each tagged with its coloured letter circle. Atomicity (blue A): all the writes commit together, or none do; a declined card means no ticket, no charge, no change. Consistency (green C): every commit leaves the rules satisfied; seats sold and revenue always move as one. Isolation (orange I): concurrent transactions never see each other's half-done work; Alice locks the last seat and Bob waits, so no double sale. Durability (violet D): once committed it survives any crash; the receipt is shown, the server dies, and the ticket is still there.
svg.text: The rule, and what each one looks like when Alice buys a ticket.

g.text: All the writes commit together, or none do.
Card declines, so no ticket, no charge, no change.
Every commit leaves the rules satisfied.
Seats sold and revenue always move as one.
Transactions don't see each other's half-work.
Alice locks the last seat; Bob waits. No double-sale.
Once committed, it survives any crash.
Receipt shown, server dies, the ticket is still there.
